map.→ 打开信息增益近似工具: -> Open the Information Gain Approximation tool
map.两者结论常一致。基尼计算免对数更快，对多数类错误更敏感；熵对不纯度变化更敏感、偏: The two often agree. Gini needs no logarithm so it is faster and is more sensitive to majority-class errors; entropy is more sensitive to impurity changes and favours many-valued features, so the gain ratio is used to correct that bias.
map.为什么信息增益偏向取值多的特征？: Why Does Information Gain Favour Features with Many Values?
map.信息增益=父节点不纯度−Σ(子节点样本占比×子节点不纯度)，用于决策树分裂特征选: Information gain = parent impurity − Σ(child sample share × child impurity), used for feature selection in decision tree splits.
map.信息增益和基尼该用哪个？: Should I Use Information Gain or Gini?
map.信息熵 H=−Σpᵢlog₂pᵢ；基尼不纯度 G=1−Σpᵢ²，均衡量节点混杂度: Information entropy H=−Σpᵢlog₂pᵢ; Gini impurity G=1−Σpᵢ². Both measure how mixed a node is.
map.决策树信息增益计算器，用基尼指数或熵评估二分类节点分裂前后的不纯度下降，辅助特征: Decision tree information gain calculator: uses the Gini index or entropy to assess the drop in impurity after splitting a binary classification node, helping feature selection and tree construction.
map.决策树分裂准则：基尼与熵都衡量节点纯度，取值越小越纯。基尼计算更快（无对数）是: Decision tree split criteria: both Gini and entropy measure node purity, and the smaller the value the purer the node. Gini is faster (no logarithm) and is the CART default; entropy is slightly more sensitive to purity changes. The splits they choose differ very little on the vast majority of datasets.
map.取值越多越容易把样本分得更纯，增益天然偏大。C4.5 用增益率(增益/分支熵)惩: More values split the samples more purely, so the gain is naturally inflated. C4.5 uses the gain ratio (gain / branch entropy) to penalise multi-valued features and correct this bias.
map.基尼 = 2p(1 − p)；加权子基尼 = w_L·2p_L(1 − p_L): Gini = 2p(1 − p); weighted sub-Gini = w_L·2p_L(1 − p_L) + (1 − w_L)·2p_R(1 − p_R); Gini gain = parent Gini − weighted sub-Gini; entropy = −p·log₂p − (1 − p)·log₂(1 − p)
map.基尼计算更快且对错误分类敏感，CART 默认用基尼，ID3/C4.5 用熵。: Gini is faster to compute and sensitive to misclassification, so CART uses Gini by default while ID3/C4.5 use entropy.

map.填写「左子树正例比例」。: Enter the "positive ratio of the left subtree".
map.填写「根节点正例比例」。: Enter the "positive ratio of the root node".
map.：父节点正类 6/负类 6，熵=1.0；按某特征分为左(5正1负)右(1正5负): : the parent node has 6 positive / 6 negative, entropy=1.0; a feature splits it into left (5 positive 1 negative) and right (1 positive 5 negative). Left entropy ≈0.65 and right entropy ≈0.65, weighted=0.5×0.65+0.5×0.65=0.65, and the information gain=1.0−0.65=0.35.
